apis.title: Get Category Attributes
apis.description_en: Retrieve the standard built-in product and sales attributes for listing a product in a particular category based on your shop's location. Products on TikTok Shop are grouped into categories predefined by TikTok Shop, and each category is associated with a standard set of product attributes and sales attributes. * **Sales attributes** (e.g. size, color, length) define product variants and are optional if your product is straightforward and has no variants. * **Product attributes** (e.g. manufacturer, country of origin, materials used) describe the product as a whole, regardless of variant. Some product attributes are mandatory based on listing policies.    Use this API to determine the mandatory and optional attributes before listing a product.    **Note**: It must be a [leaf category](6509c89d0fcef602bf1acd9b) that corresponds to the category tree type specified in the `category_version` property.

apis.title: Get Brands
apis.description_en: Retrieve brands for your shop, including the built-in brands and any custom brands created using the [Create Custom Brands API](650a0926f1fd3102b91bbfb0). Pass the returned brand ID when creating or editing a product to associate the brand with the product. * To check if a brand is fully authorized for use in a specific product category, specify the **category ID**. * To obtain the full list of brands that your shop can potentially use and their authorization status, omit the category ID. We recommend that you specify the **brand name** to narrow down the list of brands returned.    **Key concept**    Whether you can select and display a brand depends on the brand's authorization status, the categories authorized for the brand, and whether the brand is classified as T1 (internationally renowned brands that require prior brand authorization).    **- Brand selection rules**: You can only select the following types of brands during product creation/editing.    * Authorized brands which contain the desired category (`authorized_status=AUTHORIZED` and `brand_status=AVAILABLE`)    * Unauthorized non-T1 brands (`authorized_status=UNAUTHORIEZD` and `is_t1_brand=false`)       **- Brand display rules**: Note however that brands will only appear on the product display page if the brand is authorized (`authorized_status=AUTHORIZED`) and available in the desired category (`brand_status=AVAILABLE`). This means that you need to obtain brand authorization for unauthorized non-T1 brands before they can be displayed. Obtain brand authorization or add categories to an authorized brand through TikTok Shop Seller Center > Qualification Center > Brand qualification.       **For Tokopedia sellers**: You can select and display any returned brand on Tokopedia regardless of these rules.

apis.title: Diagnose and Optimize Product
apis.description_en: Diagnose products to obtain information that helps you to improve the product content, enhancing product visibility and customer trust. The returned information includes: * Listing quality information (available only for the US market). * Issues with the current product details and the overall recommendations * Auto-generated optimization suggestions targeted for specific product fields, including the title, description, and image.    This API enables you to diagnose both live products (status: `ACTIVATE`) and brand-new products not yet listed in TikTok Shop. * To diagnose a **live product**, provide the `product_id` and `category_id` and leave all other product details blank. * To diagnose a **brand-new product** not yet listed in TikTok Shop, omit the `product_id` and provide the product details as necessary. * To diagnose a **product similar to an existing one**, provide the `product_id` and `category_id`, along with any new details. The diagnosis will combine the existing product's information with the new details you provide. For example, if you provide a new `title`, the diagnosis will use the new title instead of the existing one while keeping the other values from the product ID.    **Note**: * To diagnose multiple live products, use the [Product Information Issue Diagnosis API](665048f380b6b302e73917d9). * This API focuses solely on optimizing product visibility and does not evaluate whether your product meets listing requirements. Quality issues identified by this API do not block your product from being listed. To verify listing requirements, use the [Check Product Listing API](650a0ee8f1fd3102b91c6493).

apis.title: Create Global Product
apis.description_en: Create global products to be sold in one or multiple shops outside of the seller's base country. You can only create global products in `AVAILABLE` product categories. For other categories, contact your account manager for assistance. After product creation, use the [Publish Global Product API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650a64d6defece02be678fd6) to publish and translate the product in the desired markets. **Key concept**: Global products are products created by cross-border sellers to be sold in shops outside of their base country. With global products, cross-border sellers operating across multiple markets can avoid creating the same product for each shop individually. Instead, they just need to create a single global product, which can be published and synced to all their shops, simplifying product management across markets. **Note**: * This API is applicable only for intra-EU sellers and global sellers. To create and list local products intended for sale exclusively in local shops, use the [Create Product API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6502fc8da57708028b42b18a) instead. * There may be a limit to the number of products you can list per day. We recommend prioritizing the creation of key products first to ensure they get published. You can find your listing limit on the Seller Center homepage. * The language used in the product content must align with the target market's language (e.g. don't use Chinese), otherwise the listing will fail or be rejected.

To change product information, edit the global product by using the [Edit Global Product API](6509e1bcc16ffe02b8dc3cd7). The changes will be automatically synchronized to all markets where the product is published * Use the [Get Product API](6509d85b4a0bb702c057fdda) to obtain the converted local product information in the target market's language. * Use the [Edit Product API](6509da7d0fcef602bf1caddf) or [Partial Edit Product API](650a98d74a0bb702c06c3289) to edit the local product information, if necessary.

apis.title: Edit Global Product

If you have already edited the product information or translations of the associated local products, they will be overwritten by the information in this API. For example, if you have customized the local prices such as the local pre-tax price or the local display price, they will be overwritten each time this API is called. **Note**: * There may be a limit to the number of products you can relist per day. We recommend prioritizing key products first to ensure they get published. You can find your listing limit on the Seller Center homepage. * All inputs, including blanks, in the request payload will overwrite existing values. To retain an existing value, make sure to include it in your request. Therefore, **it is strongly recommended to retrieve the latest product data using** [Get Global Product](6509e2b0bace3e02b7490c96) **and submit the complete data when editing**. This ensures accuracy and helps avoid errors or unintentional data loss due to missing fields. * The language used in the product content must align with the target market's language (e.g. don't use Chinese), otherwise the listing will fail or be rejected.

apis.title: Edit Product
apis.description_en: Edit all properties (e.g. description, brand, images) of an existing product that is not in the `FREEZE` or `DELETED` state. After editing the product, the latest product content (referred to as v2) will be resent for audit review. If the audit passes, v2 is published to the shop, otherwise, the existing product stays live and remains unchanged (keeping v1). However, edits to the `price` or `inventory` fields do not require a reaudit and will be immediately published on the platform. Use the [Product status change](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650956aff1fd3102b90b6261) webhook to keep track of the review status. **Note**: * This API is applicable only for **active sellers/shops** that have completed the KYC onboarding process. * There may be a limit to the number of products you can relist per day. We recommend prioritizing key products first to ensure they get published. You can find your listing limit on the Seller Center homepage. * All inputs, including blanks, in the request payload will overwrite existing values. To retain an existing value, make sure to include it in your request. Exceptions to this rule are the `price` and `inventory` fields, which will remain unchanged if they are omitted from the request. Therefore, **it is strongly recommended to retrieve the latest product data using** [Get Product](6509d85b4a0bb702c057fdda) **and submit the complete data when editing**. This ensures accuracy and helps avoid errors or unintentional data loss due to missing fields. * If you wish to edit only certain properties, you can use the [Partial Edit Product API](650a98d74a0bb702c06c3289), [Update Inventory API](6503068fc20ad60284b38858), or the [Update Price API](650307de5a12ff0294eac8b0). * The language used in the product content must align with the target market's language (e.g. don't use Chinese), otherwise the listing will fail or be rejected.    **For global sellers**:    If you're using the local replication listing method, note the following sync rules: * To sync any changes to other markets, please provide the `seller_sku` and complete `replicated_products` data. * Note that **category changes** and **sales attribute changes** (in sales attribute id/name) must be synced to other markets. The API call will fail if you don't provide these details.    **For Tokopedia sellers**:    Note that a product can have **only one active version** across all platforms at any time. If a product is live on both platforms, audit results for the latest version are handled as follows: * **Mixed audit results**: If the product passes audit on one platform but fails on another, on the successful platform, the product will stay live and be updated with content from the latest version (v2), while on the failed platform, the product will be deactivated and hidden entirely. * **Audit failure on all platforms**: If the product fails audit on all platforms, the existing product stays live and remains unchanged (keeping v1).

apis.title: Partial Edit Product
apis.description_en: Edit some properties (e.g. description, images, attributes) of a product that is not in the `FREEZE` or `DELETED` state. After editing the product, the latest product content (referred to as v2) will be resent for audit review. If the audit passes, v2 is published to the shop, otherwise, the existing product stays live and remains unchanged (keeping v1). However, edits to the `price` or `inventory` fields do not require a reaudit and will be immediately published on the platform. Use the [Product status change](650956aff1fd3102b90b6261) webhook to keep track of the review status. **Note**: * This API is applicable for all sellers. * There may be a limit to the number of products you can relist per day. We recommend prioritizing key products first to ensure they get published. You can find your listing limit on the Seller Center homepage. * If a draft or audit-review version exists, unedited fields will retain their values over those of the base (live) version. * **Updates are handled per top-level property**, so all non-empty fields within an updated object must be supplied to prevent overwriting with blanks. For top-level properties (e.g. `description`, `brand_id`) that are not nested in an object, you can update them individually. Omitting these properties in the request will leave them unchanged. If you need to edit any nested property within an object, you must provide values for all nested properties of that object. Any omitted nested properties will be overwritten with blanks. * If new mandatory product attributes were added by TikTok Shop after the creation of your product, ensure that you provide these attributes too.    **For global sellers**:    If you're using the local replication listing method, note the following sync rules:    **Sales attribute changes** (in sales attribute id/name) must be synced to other markets. Therefore, you must provide the `seller_sku` and complete `replicated_products` data. The API call will fail if you don't provide these details.    **New SKUs* (new sales attribute value id/name) are optional to sync to other markets. To sync, please provide the `seller_sku` and complete `replicated_products` data.    **General changes** are optional to sync to other markets. To sync, you only need to provide `replicated_products.region`.    **For Tokopedia sellers**:    Note that a product can have **only one active version** across all platforms at any time. If a product is live on both platforms, audit results for the latest version are handled as follows: * **Mixed audit results**: If the product passes audit on one platform but fails on another, on the successful platform, the product will stay live and be updated with content from the latest version (v2), while on the failed platform, the product will be deactivated and hidden entirely. * **Audit failure on all platforms**: If the product fails audit on all platforms, the existing product stays live and remains unchanged (keeping v1).

apis.title: Submit Size Chart Appeal
apis.description_en: #### Appeal Size Chart Verification Initiates an appeal process for a product that was blocked during the listing phase due to a size chart verification failure. This API is used when a seller believes their product was incorrectly blocked by our automated size chart validation system. The validation checks for three potential issues: 1. Whether the size chart contains all mandatory dimensions. 2. Whether the size chart covers all Stock-Keeping Units (SKUs) for sale. 3. Whether the numerical values within the size chart are valid.    If the validation system detects an issue, the product listing will be blocked. By using this API, sellers can submit an appeal. If the appeal is approved, the block will be lifted, and the seller can re-list the product.    Use the `[Appeal Status Webhook]` to monitor the appeal's progress, or pass the `appeal_id` to the `[Get Appeal Status API]` to retrieve the current status.    Note: * Please wait at least 5 minutes after submitting an appeal before checking its status via the API to ensure the data is synchronized. * You can submit up to 50 appeals per day. Any requests exceeding this limit will be rejected.

Create Promotion Activity
apis.description_en: Create a fixed-price, percentage-off, flash sale, shipping-discount, Buy More Save More, Gift With Purchase, or Buy X Get Y promotion activity. Coupons cannot be created with this API; create them in Seller Center or the seller app. To update the products or SKUs included in the activity, use [Update Activity Product](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650d32c42aaa3602b86ccb5c).

apis.title: Update Promotion Activity
apis.description_en: Update an existing promotion activity. The stored activity type determines which request fields are processed: * For fixed-price, direct-discount, and flash-sale activities, update title, begin_time, and end_time; the other type-specific fields are not processed by this update path. * For a shipping-discount activity, provide discount.shipping_discount; use duration_type to choose a scheduled or indefinite activity. * For a Buy More Save More (BMSM) or Buy X Get Y (BXGY) activity, set duration_type to NORMAL, set product_level to PRODUCT or SHOP, provide exactly one participation_limit entry, and provide the matching discount object. * For a Gift With Purchase (GWP) activity, set duration_type to NORMAL, set product_level to PRODUCT, provide exactly one participation_limit entry, and provide discount.gift_discount.    Fixed-price, direct-discount, flash-sale, BMSM, BXGY, and GWP activities cannot be updated after they are deactivated or expired. For those activity types, an upcoming activity with a normal schedule requires a future begin_time, while an ongoing activity must keep its existing begin_time. An ongoing BMSM or BXGY activity must also keep its existing first-tier threshold value, threshold type, discount type, product scope, participation limit, and target-user setting.

apis.title: Search Promotion Activities

apis.title: Update Promotion Activity Products
apis.description_en: Use this API as follows: * For a `FIXED_PRICE`, `DIRECT_DISCOUNT`, or `FLASHSALE` activity with PRODUCT or VARIATION scope, provide a non-empty `products` array. For VARIATION scope, add or update SKUs in each product's `skus` array. * For a PRODUCT-scoped `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT` or `GIFT_WITH_PURCHASE` activity, provide a non-empty `products` array. A SHOP-scoped shipping-discount activity is not supported by this operation, and this operation does not document nested-SKU updates for shipping-discount or Gift With Purchase. * For a PRODUCT-scoped `BUY_MORE_SAVE_MORE` or `BUY_X_GET_Y` activity, `products` can be omitted or empty when the request updates only benefit-product relations. * For a SHOP-scoped `BUY_MORE_SAVE_MORE` or `BUY_X_GET_Y` activity, omit `products` or pass an empty array; use `benefit_product_ids` or `exclude_product_ids` for the applicable relation update.    For an ongoing flash deal, you can add products or SKUs, but you cannot change the price or purchase limits of products or SKUs already in the activity. To remove products or SKUs, use [Remove Activity Product](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650acfd84a0bb702c072b4eb).

apis.title: Remove Promotion Activity Products
apis.description_en: Use this API for `FIXED_PRICE`, `DIRECT_DISCOUNT`, `FLASHSALE`, `BUY_MORE_SAVE_MORE`, `BUY_X_GET_Y`, `GIFT_WITH_PURCHASE`, and `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT` activities. Provide at least one non-empty removal list; omitting the body, sending an empty object, or sending only empty lists does not request an item removal. * When removing ordinary activity products from a PRODUCT-scoped activity, use `product_ids` and do not provide `sku_ids`. * When removing ordinary activity products or SKUs from a VARIATION-scoped activity, use `product_ids`, `sku_ids`, or both. * For `GIFT_WITH_PURCHASE`, provide a non-empty `product_ids` list; the other removal lists are not processed by its branch. * For `BUY_MORE_SAVE_MORE` or `BUY_X_GET_Y`, `benefit_product_ids` removes benefit-product relations without requiring `product_ids`. * For a SHOP-scoped `BUY_MORE_SAVE_MORE`, `BUY_X_GET_Y`, or `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT` activity, `exclude_product_ids` removes excluded-product relations.    You can provide multiple applicable non-empty lists in one ordinary non-GWP request. You cannot remove items from a `DEACTIVATED` or `EXPIRED` activity.

apis.title: Republish Activity
apis.description_en: Use this API to republish a product discount activity or a flash deal activity that expired or was deactivated within the last 7 days. This API only supports FIXED_PRICE, FLASHSALE, and DIRECT_DISCOUNT activities. You must provide a new effective period by passing the new begin_time and end_time. Products and SKUs already associated with the activity do not need to be added again. After the activity is republished, you can edit the activity and modify its products or SKUs as usual. We recommend using this API instead of recreating the activity to reduce requests to the API for adding products.

You can also apply a range of filtering criteria to narrow the list of orders returned, such as order status, delivery option type, and buyer user ID. A response is successful when `code` is `0`, including when no orders match the request.

Use this endpoint to attach external OMS references to up to 100 TikTok Shop orders. To update an existing reference, call the endpoint again with the same TikTok Shop order and OMS. Each order is processed independently. On a successful API response, references for orders not listed in `data.errors` are saved; use that list to identify per-order errors.

apis.title: Get External Order References

apis.title: Update The Blind Box Opening Results

The request supports two result shapes: `blind_box_results` contains one unboxed product per item, while `blind_batch_box_results` groups one or more unboxed products under an order line. If `blind_batch_box_results` is non-empty, the platform processes it and ignores `blind_box_results`. Buyers can then view the unboxing results in the order details.

apis.description_en: Checks whether one or more TikTok Shop orders can be split into multiple packages. For each evaluated order, the response indicates whether it can be split and may include a reason when splitting is not allowed and mandatory package-splitting limits when applicable.

apis.title: Confirm Order Split
apis.description_en: Use this API to confirm an order split. Supported split levels vary by region: * Some regions support item-level splits (splitting individual units of the same SKU). * Others only support all-units splits (splitting different SKUs into separate packages). Here are two examples of supported splits: * **Case 1: all-units split**, applicable for orders in BR, SEA, MX (local sellers)    Split a buyer order of SKU A of quantity 2 and SKU B of quantity 1 into two separate packages:    * **Package 1**: all units of SKU A    * **Package 2**: all units of SKU B * **Case 2: item-level split**, applicable for orders in EU, JP, MX (global sellers), UK, US    Split the same order contents into three individual packages:    * **Package 1**: 1 unit of SKU A    * **Package 2**: 1 unit of SKU A    * **Package 3**: 1 unit of SKU B

apis.title: Ship Package
apis.description_en: Use this API to ship a package. There are two kinds of shipping options available: `TikTok Shipping` or `Seller Shipping`. * `TikTok Shipping`: Schedule a package handover time for TikTok Shipping carriers to pickup a package from seller. * `Seller Shipping`: Seller arranges their own shipping, and uploads a tracking number and `shipping_provider_id`. Package ID can be obtained from [Get Order Detail](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650aa8ccc16ffe02b8f167a0?external_id=650aa8ccc16ffe02b8f167a0#Back%20To%20Top). * `In-store Pickup`: Confirms shipment and notifies the buyer that the order is ready for pickup.

apis.title: Batch Ship Packages
apis.description_en: Use this API to ship one or more packages in a single request. The API supports TikTok Shipping, Seller Shipping, and In-store Pickup. * `TikTok Shipping`: Set each package's `handover_method` to `PICKUP` for carrier pickup from the seller's pickup address, or to `DROP_OFF` when the seller will drop it off at a designated location. * `Seller Shipping`: Provide `self_shipment.shipping_provider_id` and `self_shipment.tracking_number` for each package. Obtain package IDs from [Get Order Detail](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650aa8ccc16ffe02b8f167a0?external_id=650aa8ccc16ffe02b8f167a0). * `In-store Pickup`: Confirm shipment and notify the buyer that the order is ready for pickup. A response with a top-level `code` of `0` can still contain package-specific failures. Check `data.errors` before treating every package as shipped.

apis.title: Cancel FBT MCF Order

You can retrieve IDs that have already been assigned by calling the **Get FBT MCF Order Status** API; use IDs returned while the target consign orders are still in a cancellable pre-shipment state. Cancellation is rejected for target consign orders that have reached `SHIPPED`, `HANDOVER`, `COMPLETED`, or a shipping-exception state such as `LOST`, `DAMAGE`, `RETURNED`, or `SCRAP`. apis.title: Get Inbound Method Detail

First call the List Available Inbound Methods API for the plan, then use the `inbound_method` and estimated arrival window from the same returned option. The response reports the placement task status and, when available, placement options with shipment allocations; `ONE_HUB` options can also include an estimated placement fee.

apis.title: Print Inbound Order Labels
apis.description_en: This API generates label files for an inbound order using an **asynchronous Long-Running Operation (LRO)**. The inbound order must be shipped or in a later eligible status and must not be canceled. **Format applicability** * `carton_label_format` controls the carton or pallet label layout only when `print_items` includes `CARTON_PALLET_LABEL`. * `barcode_format` controls the goods-barcode label layout only when `print_items` includes `FBT_BARCODE`. The selected `print_items` and both resolved format values are part of the print task identifier, so keep the same selections in every polling request. **Workflow** 1. **Initiate.** Send a request with the child inbound `order_id` and the desired `print_items`. The API returns `PROCESSING` while the label file is being generated; a completed task for the same request values may return `SUCCESS` immediately. 2. **Poll.** If `task_status` is `PROCESSING`, repeat the request with the same `order_id`, `print_items`, `carton_label_format`, and `barcode_format` values. Poll every 3–5 seconds. 3. **Complete.** When `task_status` is `SUCCESS`, `download_url` contains the generated ZIP file.

apis.title: Update Inbound Order Tracking
apis.description_en: Updates carton-level tracking information for an inbound order after shipment and before the order is marked as `Delivered` or `Received`. When updating tracking, send the complete desired `parcel_tracking_info` list; entries omitted from a non-empty submission are not retained, so this is not a partial patch. The first tracking value for a carton does not count as an edit, and resubmitting the same normalized value does not consume another edit. Changing an existing carton's tracking number consumes one of the five allowed edits for that carton; a sixth change is rejected before the local update. The submitted carton updates are applied atomically to the stored tracking list: either the complete local replacement is saved or none of it is. Warehouse synchronization and logistics tracking registration occur outside this atomic update; warehouse synchronization failures are not returned, and tracking registration runs asynchronously.

apis.title: Confirm Inbound Method

First call the List Available Inbound Methods API and select an `inbound_method` with one exact `estimate_arrival_time` window. Then call the Get Inbound Method Detail API with that selection and choose a returned `placement_option_id`. Confirm using the `placement_option_id`, `inbound_method`, and `estimate_arrival_time` from the same selection. If the option has expired, repeat both prerequisite calls to obtain a current selection and a new `placement_option_id`, then retry.
